verdict.rationale: Asking whether a business registry offers event webhooks is a fair question, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The "Data and Image Subscriptions" and "Farm Product Monthly Subscription" items are bulk data or periodic subscription products, and the newsletter inbox signup is email. None of these are programmatic webhook subscriptions, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
